method: Coordinate model of the figure; count triangles by enumerating vertex triples joined by drawn segments
steps: Rectangle with inscribed diamond, vertical mid-line, half-horizontal from centre to right vertex, two corner diagonals and a lower horizontal chord
Inside diamond: left half 2, right half 4, full chord triangle 1 = 7

from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations
def count(segs):
    segs=[((F(a),F(b)),(F(c),F(d))) for (a,b),(c,d) in segs]
    def inter(s,t):
        (x1,y1),(x2,y2)=s;(x3,y3),(x4,y4)=t
        den=(x1-x2)*(y3-y4)-(y1-y2)*(x3-x4)
        if den==0: return None
        u=((x1-x3)*(y3-y4)-(y1-y3)*(x3-x4))/den
        v=((x1-x3)*(y1-y2)-(y1-y3)*(x1-x2))/den
        eps=F(1,50)
        if -eps<=u<=1+eps and -eps<=v<=1+eps:
            return (x1+u*(x2-x1),y1+u*(y2-y1)), u
        return None
    pts=[]
    def addp(p):
        for q in pts:
            if abs(q[0]-p[0])<4 and abs(q[1]-p[1])<4: return q
        pts.append(p); return p
    on={i:set() for i in range(len(segs))}
    for i,s in enumerate(segs):
        on[i].add(addp(s[0])); on[i].add(addp(s[1]))
    for i,j in combinations(range(len(segs)),2):
        r=inter(segs[i],segs[j])
        if r:
            p=addp(r[0]); on[i].add(p); on[j].add(p)
    n=0
    for a,b,c in combinations(pts,3):
        def conn(p,q): return [i for i in on if p in on[i] and q in on[i]]
        ab,bc,ca=conn(a,b),conn(b,c),conn(c,a)
        if ab and bc and ca and not (set(ab)&set(bc)&set(ca)):
            n+=1
    return n
